'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] accuses [[Ukraine]] of a [[drone attack]] on its [[Black Sea Fleet]] [[headquarters]] in [[Sevastopol]], [[Crimea]]. The [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|Russian-installed]] [[Governor of Sevastopol (Russia)|Governor of Sevastopol]] [[Mikhail Razvozhayev]] says the [[Russian Navy]] repelled the attack, which he calls the "most massive" since the [[invasion]] began. Russia consequently suspends its participation in the [[Black Sea Grain Initiative]]. [https://www.npr.org/2022/10/29/1132608672/russia-says-it-is-suspending-a-grain-export-deal-with-ukraine (NPR)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63437212 (BBC News)] 
**[[2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage]]
***Russia accuses the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Royal Navy]] of blowing up the [[Nord Stream 1]] and [[Nord Stream 2]] gas pipelines in the [[Baltic Sea]] on September 26. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says the Navy was also behind recent attacks on [[Russian Navy]] facilities in [[Crimea]]. The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] denies both accusations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-british-navy-personnel-blew-up-nord-stream-gas-pipelines-2022-10-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] gunman kills an [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[Israeli settlement|settler]] in [[Kiryat Arba]], [[Hebron]], and injures four others, including a [[Palestinian]] [[paramedic]], before being killed by security forces. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/5-people-hurt-one-critically-in-shooting-attack-on-west-bank-settlement/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[October 2022 Mogadishu bombings]]
***At least 100 people are killed and over 300 others are injured by an [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] double [[car bomb]]ing in [[Mogadishu]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/29/two-blasts-target-somalias-education-ministry-police/ (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Nalgae (2022)|Tropical Storm Nalgae]]
***The death toll from floods and [[landslide]]s caused by Tropical Storm Nalgae (Paeng) in the [[Philippines]] increases to 45 with at least 14 people reported missing. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/29/world/asia/philippines-storm-nalgae.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Seoul Halloween crowd crush]]
**At least 151 people are killed and 82 others injured in a [[crowd crush]] during [[Halloween]] celebrations in [[Itaewon]], [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/society/society_general/1064836.html (''The Hankyoreh'')]
*A gas tanker explosion at an [[amateur sports|amateur]] [[association football|football]] game in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], kills nine people and wounds 10 others. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-explosions-iraq-baghdad-muqtada-al-sadr-334dc3b71b1fdc4f07fcfe596beabfe5 (AP)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**A suspect arrested in 2019 for the deaths of 39 [[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese]] [[illegal immigrant]]s in a lorry in southern [[England]] has been formally charged with 39 counts of [[Manslaughter in English law|manslaughter]] and [[conspiracy (criminal)|conspiracy]] to assist [[Illegal immigration to the United Kingdom|illegal immigration]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2022/oct/29/man-charged-over-lorry-deaths-of-39-vietnamese-nationals-in-essex (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The first trial related to the protests following the [[death of Mahsa Amini]] begins in the [[Islamic Revolutionary Court]] of [[Tehran]]. The five protesters face charges of [[corruption on earth]], which is [[Capital punishment in Iran|punishable by death]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/10/29/Iran-trial-opens-for-five-people-facing-death-penalty-over-protests (Al Arabiya)]
*[[2022 Brazilian general election]]
**[[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Congresswoman]] and [[Jair Bolsonaro|Bolsonaro]] supporter [[Carla Zambelli]] draws a handgun and chases a [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva|Lula]] supporter in [[São Paulo]]. Zambelli claimed to have been assaulted by the man, but video footage shows that Zambelli tripped and fell to the ground before chasing him. [https://brazilian.report/liveblog/2022/10/29/bolsonaro-congresswoman-carla-zambelli-weapon/ (''The Brazilian Report'')]
